I have farmed this small plot for many years using only manure from my goats and chickens, and the soil still gives us food. I cannot afford chemical fertilizer or improved seed when my other plots also need attention, and the rains in Mbeya have always been sufficient for this land. My daughters and I will tend this plot with our hoes over about twenty days this season, as hiring workers costs too much money.
